lines.speaker: Professor Quill
lines.text: My notebook! Forty years of ruin rubbings, saved. You've earned this, my friend.

lines.speaker: Professor Quill
lines.text: Drat and dust devils! The wind snatched my notebook clean up onto the high plateau.

lines.speaker: Professor Quill
lines.text: It'll be up by the stacked mesas, I'm sure. Bring it back and I'll share a little treasure I dug up.
